title: People who act in the system: identity and roles (private store, identities/people.yaml)
description: Holds names and emails, so the live file lives only in the private store (decision 0006). Role slugs are checked against config.ROLES in code, which keeps one list of roles.

instructor.description: Optional, additive to people@1 (decision 0012). The roster instructor this person is: the only link between a people-list person and an instructor URI. A mapped person acts as that instructor in sign-offs (signer = the instructor URI, sender = the person's mailbox), holds their roles in the people list and, when the instructor is registered, counts as a clearer or coach for the observation rotation if they hold that role. Nothing is inferred from slugs or mailboxes.

coaches.description: Optional, additive to people@1 (decision 0014), only on a row holding the coach role (config.people checks this). The instructors this person coaches (W7). flows.common.coaches_of reads it: a coach of an instructor is the `instructor` this person is mapped to, and a coach with no mapping is ignored for the observer and clearer limits, which are about instructor URIs. A coach who lists nobody coaches nobody.
